color.description:
Represents a hexadecimal color in the configuration corresponding to given label and value.
Supports a default set of the 10 colors. Any of the below colors can be used while creating a {@link ThresholdConfig}.

| Hex Color   | Color Name |
|-------------|------------|
| `#DB1C3C`   | Red        |
| `#ED6921`   | Orange     |
| `#F2950A`   | Yellow     |
| `#6CA11D`   | Green      |
| `#0CA0AB`   | Cyan       |
| `#4F8DFF`   | Blue       |
| `#9E933F`   | Olive      |
| `#B073FF`   | Purple     |
| `#D96AB6`   | Plum       |
| `#FFFFFF`   | White      |


To modify the list of colors, modify the enum type {@link ThresholdConfigColor}, and update the model-classification-label-colors list in the `ModelClassificationLabelColorMixins.scss` file.

**NOTE**:
1. The colors in the model-classification-label-colors should ONLY be a **hexcode defined as a string**.
2. The same restriction applies to the values of the {@link ThresholdConfigColor} enum.
3. If the color is not defined in the `ModelClassificationLabelColorMixins.scss` file, then it **will not** show up in the UI.

value.description: Represents the value in the configuration corresponding to given color and label

label.description: Represents the label for the configuration corresponding to given color and value

title: A generic helper type used to maintain the mapping between trio of color, value and label.
name: ThresholdConfig
